overall: The AG found no violation because the Board created and approved the September 11, 2015 executive session minutes; the accuracy and approval-timing complaints were declined as untimely, and website posting is not required.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to create and approve minutes of its September 11, 2015 executive session meeting.
allegations.key_passage: It is clear that the minutes were indeed created and approved.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the approved September 11, 2015 executive session minutes were inaccurate.
allegations.key_passage: To the extent that the complaint alleges that the minutes which the Board approved were inaccurate, such an allegation is untimely and, accordingly, we decline to review it.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to post the minutes to a municipal website.
allegations.key_passage: the Open Meeting Law does not require that public bodies post minutes to a website.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to approve the September 11, 2015 minutes in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: such an allegation would be untimely, and we therefore decline to review it.
